name: Gym Fee Dues Report
query:
SELECT
  `tabGym Membership`.name as "Membership:Link/Gym Membership:150",
  `tabGym Membership`.full_name as "Member Name:Data:150",
  `tabGym Membership`.phone__number as "Phone Number:Data:120",
  `tabGym Membership`.subscription_plan as "Plan:Data:120",
  `tabGym Membership`.total_amount as "Total Amount:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Membership`.amount_paid as "Amount Paid:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Membership`.balance as "Balance Due:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Membership`.fee_paid as "Status:Select/Paid,Unpaid,Partially Paid:120",
  `tabGym Membership`.date_of_registration as "Registered On:Date:120"
FROM `tabGym Membership`
WHERE `tabGym Membership`.docstatus = 1
  AND `tabGym Membership`.balance > 0
ORDER BY `tabGym Membership`.balance DESC
